answer: A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 19 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a thread bet on surviving 108 epochs of grading, and every beacon settlement recomputes the garden schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 108 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
